title: Exposure to responsible components of PM(2.5) induces hepatic steatosis: An in silico, in vitro, and in vivo study based on adverse outcome pathway.
authors: Yan, Zhipeng; Nan, Nan; Wang, Yue; Luo, Bi; Zhang, Yaru; Li, Shiya; Dang, Dou; Qin, Guohua
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用分子动力学模拟和双荧光素酶实验鉴定PM2.5组分激活核受体（PPARgamma等）诱导肝脂肪变性，虽涉及蛋白-配体模拟，但核心是环境毒理与核受体-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上MD可部分借鉴。
abstract: Mounting evidence suggests that exposure to PM(2.5) is closely associated with hepatic steatosis. However, due to the complex composition of PM(2.5), evidence regarding the effects of its specific chemical components on hepatic steatosis remains insufficient. This study aims to expand our previous research by investigating whether direct exposure to PM(2.5)-bound responsible components induces hepatic steatosis. Additionally, we seek to elucidate the molecular mechanisms based on an adverse outcome pathway (AOP) strategy. Initially, molecular dynamics simulations and dual-luciferase assays identified several responsible components of PM(2.5) that activate PPARgamma, ERalpha, and LXRalpha, or antagonize PPARalpha-molecular initiation events (MIEs) that are critical for inducing hepatic steatosis. Subsequently, these components were systematically evaluated for their capacity to induce lipid metabolism abnormalities (key events, KEs) and hepatic steatosis (adverse outcome, AO) in HepG2 cells. The results indicate that all studied components induced lipid accumulation, with tris-2-ethylhexyl phosphate (TEHP) prioritized as the highest-risk compound. Finally, in vivo validation indicated that TEHP chronic exposure resulted in hepatic steatosis and composition alterations in mice. This study underscores the effectiveness of AOP-based strategies in prioritizing chemicals and is anticipated to establish a paradigm for mechanism-oriented screening of hazardous components in complex environmental samples.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，暴露于PM(2.5)与肝脂肪变性密切相关。然而，由于PM(2.5)成分复杂，关于其特定化学成分对肝脂肪变性影响的证据仍不充分。本研究旨在扩展我们先前的研究，探讨直接暴露于PM(2.5)中相关责任成分是否诱导肝脂肪变性。此外，我们寻求基于不良结局路径（adverse outcome pathway, AOP）策略阐明分子机制。首先，分子动力学模拟和双荧光素酶实验鉴定出PM(2.5)中若干激活PPARgamma、ERalpha和LXRalpha，或拮抗PPARalpha的責任成分——这些是诱导肝脂肪变性关键的分子起始事件（molecular initiation events, MIEs）。随后，系统评估了这些成分在HepG2细胞中诱导脂质代谢异常（关键事件，KEs）和肝脂肪变性（不良结局，AO）的能力。结果表明，所有研究的成分均诱导脂质积累，其中三(2-乙基己基)磷酸酯（tris-2-ethylhexyl phosphate, TEHP）被优先列为最高风险化合物。最后，体内验证表明，TEHP慢性暴露导致小鼠肝脂肪变性和成分改变。本研究强调了基于AOP策略在化学品优先级排序中的有效性，并预期为复杂环境样品中有害成分的机制导向筛选建立范式。
